Operating cash flow declined 27% year-over-year to $260.6M despite stable revenue, cash fell to $185.9M while debt rose to $1.2B, and operating margin compressed from 16.6% to 14.5%. The company is pursuing a large $1.45B acquisition funded with $318M of equity dilution despite organic revenue growth of only 3.7%, weak cash generation, and deteriorating profitability. Concrete impacts from tariffs and currency headwinds materialized in 2025, while 80% international revenue exposure and 5% Russia operations create ongoing geopolitical risk. R&D at 1.5% of revenue appears light for a company positioning on innovation. The combination of weak organic growth, deteriorating cash conversion, increasing leverage, imminent dilution, and geopolitical/trade headwinds outweighs exposure to a fragmented market and the theoretical benefits of the EBXai operating system.
